card.name: Singular person nouns after "the"
card.fires_on: The noun for a single person (woman, man, student, person, human being) right after "the", often as the subject being addressed or discussed. Also the last letters of WOMAN in capitals.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word to be a word ending that continues the sentence after a person noun, but the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on a single person noun, most of all "woman", after "the".
